notes:
WI-04 (UC-010) — IMapyClient typed HttpClient + resilience/circuit-breaker + HttpMessageHandler test seam.

== WHAT WAS DELIVERED ==

1. GeoResult<T>: abstract record GeoResult<T> with Success(Value) and Unavailable(Reason) subtypes. GeoUnavailableReason enum: Timeout (catch-all for exceptions), ServerError (5xx or null body), CircuitOpen (BrokenCircuitException).

2. MapyDtos.cs: Internal STJ-deserialization classes for Mapy.com API responses: MapySuggestResponse/Item/Position/RegionalStructureItem, MapyGeocodeResponse, MapyRgeocodeResponse, MapyRouteResponse/Route/GeometryPoint.

3. MapySuggestResult.cs: Output records: MapySuggestResult(Label, Street?, Municipality?, Lat, Lng), MapyRouteResultData(DistanceMeters, DurationSeconds, Geometry), MapyGeoPoint(Lat, Lng), MapyGeocodeResult(Found, Label?, Lat?, Lng?), MapyRgeocodeResult(Found, Label?, Street?, Municipality?).

4. IMapyClient: interface with SuggestAsync, GeocodeAsync, ReverseGeocodeAsync, RouteAsync — each returning GeoResult<T>.

5. MapyClientResilienceExtensions.AddMapyResilienceHandler: Polly v8 pipeline (inner-to-outer): (a) TimeoutStrategyOptions 4s; (b) RetryStrategyOptions<HttpResponseMessage> MaxRetryAttempts=1 on 5xx; (c) CircuitBreakerStrategyOptions<HttpResponseMessage> FailureRatio=0.5, MinimumThroughput=5, SamplingDuration=30s, BreakDuration=30s. MinimumThroughput=5 is intentionally low so tests can open the breaker within a bounded call count while still being realistic for production.

6. MapyClient: typed HttpClient implementing IMapyClient. URL patterns: /v1/suggest?apikey={key}&lang=cs&type=regional.address,regional.street,poi&limit=5&query={q}. Route URL: /v1/routing/route?apikey={key}&lang=cs&routeType=car_fast&start={fromLng},{fromLat}&end={toLng},{toLat}. Geometry >200 points stride-downsampled client-side preserving first and last. BrokenCircuitException caught → CircuitOpen. OperationCanceledException when ct.IsCancellationRequested propagated (not swallowed). All other exceptions → Timeout. Key NEVER logged.

7. MapyKeyResolver: resolves (1) Unprotect(fleetSettings.MapyServerKey) if non-null/non-empty, (2) config[Mapy__ServerKey] env fallback.

8. GeoFeatureConfiguration: Added MapyClient typed HttpClient (base address from Mapy:BaseUrl config, default https://api.mapy.cz/) with AddMapyResilienceHandler; registered IMapyClient as singleton pointing at MapyClient; registered MapyKeyResolver as singleton. KEPT legacy photon/osrm named clients and IGeoProvider/PhotonOsrmGeoProvider intact for WI-07.

9. StubMapyHttpHandler: programmable HttpMessageHandler recording CallCount. Supports fixed status+body, factory function, AlwaysServiceUnavailable() static, AlwaysDelay(TimeSpan) static.

10. MapyClientHandlerTests (6 tests, no Testcontainers): SuggestAsync_Success_ParsesStreetAndMunicipality, SuggestAsync_FiveConsecutive503_OpensBreakerAndSkipsUpstream, RouteAsync_Timeout_ReturnsUnavailableNotThrow, RouteAsync_Success_ParsesDistanceDurationGeometry, RouteAsync_LargeGeometry_SimplifiedToAtMost200Points, SuggestAsync_Success_RequestUrlContainsTypeAndLangParams.

== WHAT REMAINS FOR WI-07 ==
- Delete PhotonOsrmGeoProvider.cs and IGeoProvider.cs
- Replace FakeGeoProvider with FakeGeoService implementing IGeoService
- Repoint QuoteEndpoint, SuggestEndpoint, RouteEndpoint from IGeoProvider to IGeoService
- Remove FakeGeoProvider registration from TaxiApiFactory
- Remove photon/osrm named clients from GeoFeatureConfiguration

== KEY TRAPS DISCOVERED ==
- Czech locale trap: test-generated JSON must use CultureInfo.InvariantCulture for double.ToString() — Czech locale uses comma as decimal separator, producing invalid JSON (e.g. 50,001 instead of 50.001).
- Polly v8 API: AddRetry/AddCircuitBreaker/AddTimeout come from Polly namespace (not Http namespace). Use RetryStrategyOptions<HttpResponseMessage>, CircuitBreakerStrategyOptions<HttpResponseMessage>, TimeoutStrategyOptions. AddResilienceHandler returns IHttpResiliencePipelineBuilder, not IHttpClientBuilder — return the original builder.
- Test isolation: each BuildClient() call creates a fresh ServiceProvider with fresh circuit breaker state. Test DI container must set client.BaseAddress so relative URLs in MapyClient resolve against the stub handler.
